chapter.heading: Lovers Reunited at Their Country Home
chapter.v:
Oh, that
you were like my brother, Who nursed at my mother’s breasts! If I should find you outside, I would kiss you; I would not be despised.

I would
lead you and bring you Into the house of my mother, She who used to instruct me.I would cause you to drink of spiced wine, Of the juice of my pomegranate.
chapter.heading: (To the Daughters of Jerusalem)
chapter.v:
His left
hand is under my head, And his right hand embraces me.

I charge
you, O daughters of Jerusalem, Do not stir up nor awaken love Until it pleases.
chapter.heading: Love Renewed in Lebanon
A Relative
chapter.v:
Who is
this coming up from the wilderness, Leaning upon her beloved? I awakened you under the apple tree.There your mother brought you forth; There she who bore you brought you forth.
chapter.heading: The Shulamite to Her Beloved
chapter.v:
Set me
as a seal upon your heart, As a seal upon your arm; For love is as strong as death, Jealousy as cruel as the grave; Its flames are flames of fire, A most vehement flame.

Many waters
cannot quench love, Nor can the floods drown it.If a man would give for love All the wealth of his house, It would be utterly despised.
chapter.heading: The Shulamite’s Brothers
chapter.v:
We have
a little sister, And she has no breasts.What shall we do for our sister In the day when she is spoken for?

If she
is a wall, We will build upon her A battlement of silver; And if she is a door, We will enclose her With boards of cedar.
chapter.heading: The Shulamite
chapter.v:
I am
a wall, And my breasts like towers; Then I became in his eyes As one who found peace.

Solomon had
a vineyard at Baal Hamon; He leased the vineyard to keepers; Everyone was to bring for its fruit A thousand silver coins.
chapter.heading: (To Solomon)
chapter.v:
My own
vineyard is before me.You, O Solomon, may have a thousand, And those who tend its fruit two hundred.
chapter.heading: The Beloved
chapter.v:
You who
dwell in the gardens, The companions listen for your voice—Let me hear it!
chapter.heading: The Shulamite
chapter.v:
Make haste,
my beloved, And be like a gazelle Or a young stag On the mountains of spices.
